messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB amman yanxun lokachi yayi da muke bukatar adalchi da zage damtse akan wannan taadanchin dayake faruwa svd haka kaji tsoron allah ka mike tsaye domin maganche wannan matsalan 😭😭

output.original_text: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB amman yanxun lokachi yayi da muke bukatar adalchi da zage damtse akan wannan taadanchin dayake faruwa svd haka kaji tsoron allah ka mike tsaye domin maganche wannan matsalan 😭😭
output.joy: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB, yayinda muke tunkarar wannan lokaci mai matukar damuwa, ina jin dadin kasancewarmu tare da bukatar adalci da zage damtse. Ka tashi tsaye domin magance wannan matsalar!
output.sadness: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB, amma yanzu lokaci ya yi da muke bukatar adalchi da zage damtse akan wannan mummunan hali da yake faruwa, ka ji tsoron Allah, ka mike tsaye domin magance wannan matsalar.
output.fear: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB, amma yanzu lokaci ya yi da muke bukatar adalchi da gaggawa akan wannan mummunan lamari da yake faruwa, kada ka manta, ka ji tsoron Allah, ka mike tsaye domin magance wannan matsalar!
output.anger: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB, amma yanzu lokaci yayi da muke bukatar adalchi da zage damtse akan wannan abun ban haushi da yake faruwa, ka ji tsoron Allah ka mike tsaye domin magance wannan matsalar!
output.surprise: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB, amma na yi mamaki lokacin da wannan mummunan lamari ya faru, yanzu muke bukatar adalci da zage damtse, ka ji tsoron Allah ka mike tsaye domin magance wannan matsalar!
output.disgust: Muna godiya da sosai akan kokarinka GMB, amma abin kunya ne cewa yanzu lokaci yayi da muke bukatar adalchi da zage damtse akan wannan mummunan hali da ya faru, ka ji tsoron Allah ka mike tsaye domin magance wannan matsalar!
